# Project Governance 2.9.0

Main agents can receive complete routed context through optional Codex hooks. The integration
submits source text and required skills on the first prompt, supports explicit scope refresh,
and replays unchanged packets after compaction or resume. Missing or stale required content is
reported as incomplete. Submission does not prove that the model followed the text.

Optional TypeSafe JEV selection scores project-authorized extra context. Required sources and
skills remain deterministic. The feature is off by default. Missing developer readiness, refused
egress, timeouts and provider errors retain ordinary local routing. An explicit synthetic setup
probe reads JEV_TOKEN from the process environment; no credential is stored in project files.

Start with shadow mode, which records proposed reductions without changing the packet. Byte
reductions are not measured billed LLM token savings. Relevance quality, net savings and latency
require a representative project pilot before enabling filtering.

Adoption is deliberate; automatic runtime upgrades remain disabled for this release. Install
2.9.0 before adding the optional profile settings. Enable context delivery explicitly and review
and trust the resulting Codex hooks. If startup updates are already enabled, the integration
composes their guidance with context; installing context alone does not enable updates. Other
hosts and child-agent delivery remain caller-owned.

See the [configuration and setup instructions](https://github.com/copper-labs/project-governance/blob/2.9.0/docs/specs/semantic-context-selection.md#implemented-operator-surface).
